messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2147 — P1 — us-west-2 (az-b) capacity / 5xx spike detected. Symptoms: allocation failures, OOM evictions, and 30% increase in 5xx across serving fleet.

pagerduty: INC-2147 — paging oncall (alex) — escalation policy: SRE -> Eng Lead.

alex: acked. joining bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident/INC-2147 

alex: quick status? is this capacity or networking?

maria: seeing big KVCACHE evictions around az-b-*. kernel logs show frequent OOM kill on inferencer processes. memory reclaim spikes at 14:02 UTC.

sam: confirmed. autoscaler didn't spin up additional nodes. API rate steady but per-node token latency up ~2.5x.

jamie: tagging customer-impact: a subset of Dedicated customers in us-west-2 reporting timeouts and 5xx. CS alerted.

kyle: checking infra metrics — disk io and pagefaults high on the pod hosts. not pure network.

alex: immediate mitigations: 1) activate regional fallback to us-west-1 2) enable emergency burst (reserved pool) 3) start node addition in az-b ASG. who can run the fallback?

maria: I can run fallback toggle. executing now.

maria: ```
# enable fallback routing
./ops/routing toggle-fallback --from-region us-west-2 --to-region us-west-1 --policy graceful --reason "az-b eviction storm"
# verify
curl -sS https://console.redwood/api/v1/routing/region-status | jq '."us-west-2"'
```

maria: fallback started at 14:07 UTC. traffic steering: 35% -> us-west-1, 65% remains until further notice.

sam: I'm scaling the ASG in az-b now: ```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name rg-az-b-serving --desired-capacity 12
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/serve-inferencer
```

sam: nodes provisioning (started). evictions dropping on restarted pods.

alex: pagerduty: please escalate to ENG-MGMT and alert CS leads. PD INC-2147 bridge: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2147

pagerduty: INC-2147 escalated to ENG-MGMT. notification sent to #exec-alerts.

customer-success: notified affected accounts. flagged for SLA review. prepping customer comms draft.

kyle: quick diff in kernel params might help — bump vm.min_free_kbytes on the hot hosts to reduce reclaim churn. applying to candidate hosts.

maria: applied vm tuning on 3 hot hosts. memory pressure metrics improving. 5xx rate decreased from 32% -> 9% in 6m.

alex: rebalancing complete. increasing fallback to 50% while we let az-b heal.

jamie: monitoring: error rate trending down, latency back toward baseline. customers on Dedicated seeing reduced errors but partial degradation persisted for a short window.

maria: rolling back fallback slowly: plan 50% -> 25% -> 0 over 30 minutes if metrics stable. will annotate runbook.

sam: ASG reached desired capacity and node readiness at 14:16 UTC. no new OOMs after restarts.

alex: good work. current status: PD INC-2147; impact reduced; mitigation active (fallback 50%, node scale in progress, vm tuning). joining handoff to oncall-next in 20m.

kyle: tagging potential root cause: workload distribution + cold KV cache pressure + insufficient min_free_kbytes for newer kernels. include in postmortem.

maria: creating incident ticket and initial timeline. I'll own postmortem (maria).

alex: handing off to @jamie (oncall-next) at 14:20 UTC. jamie, please continue monitoring and coordinate full rollback.

jamie: acked. will monitor for 60m. leaving fallback at 50% for now. prepping notes for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2147 status updated: mitigations applied, severity reduced to P2 pending verification.

alex: closing active paging for now. will reopen if metrics regress. great coordination, team. :thumbsup:

jamie: last note — CS to send a follow-up to affected customers with timeline and mitigation summary.

maria: postmortem ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2147 — adding logs and kernel traces.

incident-bot: INC-2147 archived to incidents log.

alex: thread archived at 14:28 UTC.
